caller_authority: Tern next-task directive for MP-IMG4 (baseline 669fafca318944066596368e2ca73b37859d1781) under the Caller's resumption instruction and ADR-0014. Round-1 review repairs are included in this record.

profile.debug_note: The debug profile aborts with a main-thread stack overflow on this host regardless of this change (§19.214); native sets use release.

round_1_review_repairs: B-01: eviction no longer asserts transfer termination after drop_image; an in-flight payload stays quarantined and charged, and is released only by a superseded device generation (release_terminated_generation), which also refuses the current generation
B-02: discard_unpainted enforces the same consumer-ownership rule as evict, so a shared frame cannot be released while another consumer presents it
B-03: the window-close sweep counts frames this window owns that could not be released (consumer still present or paint in flight) as skipped instead of silently ignoring them
A-01: attach registers its consumer in the same service lock section evict uses, so a concurrent eviction cannot destroy the frame between the registry check and the registration

A-02: the manifest now checks paint progress through the frame's own scene flag instead of a fixed sleep, detaches only one of the two shared consumers and requires the remaining one to block eviction natively, and exits non-zero on any violated expectation

implementation.ownership: ConsumerId + attach/detach on the process-wide ImageUploadService; a frame is evictable only when its consumer set is empty, and every release path enforces that rule.
implementation.eviction: evict(frame, window) refuses NotRetained, PaintInProgress, ConsumersRemain or NotOwnedByWindow, then calls Window::drop_image for every tile, releases a never-uploaded admission, or quarantines an in-flight admission and keeps it charged, removes the frame and prunes idle generation pools.
implementation.release_condition: release_terminated_generation(generation, current) releases quarantined payloads only for a generation strictly older than the current one and only when no retained frame still belongs to it; the current generation is refused and returns 0.
implementation.window_close: evict_owned_by(window) sweeps every frame the window owns, reports evicted/skipped/images/released/quarantined bytes, and counts consumer-held frames as skipped.
implementation.lazy_recreation: A new device generation creates a pool on first use, an evicted or stale frame is re-prepared on demand, and painting an evicted identity returns PaintStatus::Evicted.
implementation.counters: evicted_frames, dropped_atlas_images, released_payload_bytes, asserted_release_bytes and consumers extend ImageUploadCounters; the media pool exposes confirm_generation_terminated and the existing frame cap (two frames, 32 MiB raster + 32 MiB tile payload) is unchanged.

manifest.shared_identity: shared@1 is prepared once, attached by two consumers, must survive the first detach, and is evicted only after the second

sampled_working_set.method: external PowerShell sampler polling Get-Process WorkingSet64 every 150 ms while the process ran
sampled_working_set.note: Sampled working set for one run immediately before exit; not a sum of declared budgets and not a GPU figure.
